subject.title: fix(codex): reject hex/exponent computer wait duration strings

question: Is helper-level exact-head proof sufficient here, or must the PR first demonstrate that its accepted duration grammar matches the downstream computer tool parser or schema?
rationale: The patch behavior is internally coherent, but only the owner of the Codex computer integration can safely confirm whether fractional and decimal strings are unsupported inputs or an existing compatibility path.

options.title: Require canonical contract proof
options.body: Confirm or reuse the downstream duration parser and add an integration-level case before merging the grammar change.

options.title: Accept the narrowed grammar
options.body: Merge the current implementation after explicitly confirming that non-integer duration strings are unsupported and may fall back to the baseline deadline.

recommendation.title: Require canonical contract proof
recommendation.body: Confirm or reuse the downstream duration parser and add an integration-level case before merging the grammar change.
